justifications.fit: the new constants and helper follow worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py:1269-1288, and the only blemish is the docstring example at :1292 citing the wrong quantity.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the three repairs land where the goal names them, at imas_codex/llm/prompts/sn/generate_name_dd_names.md:277, imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py:1451 and imas_codex/llm/prompts/sn/generate_name_system.md:104.
justifications.reuse: the text rule extends the owner at imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py:1265 with optional keywords rather than forking a second guard, and a search of imas_codex/standard_names found no existing stated-operation detector.
